rootCause.class: binding-verification (feedback_glass_ui_binding_verification.md) — listener on a reka forwarding component dropped across the Slot/forwardRef boundary
evidence: reka-ui/dist/Slider/SliderRoot.js:17 — `inheritAttrs: false`: the consumer's `@pointerdown` lands in $attrs and is NOT spread onto the rendered host.
reka-ui/dist/Slider/SliderRoot.js:148-179 — SliderRoot renders a CollectionSlot whose child carries reka's OWN `onPointerdown` at _cache[0]:159 (it SHADOWS, not merges, the consumer's attr listener).

reka-ui/dist/Slider/SliderImpl.js:33-48 — the ACTUAL host is `Primitive` (`data-slider-impl`), which binds reka's own `onPointerdown` (_cache[1]:46 → setPointerCapture). The consumer's `@pointerdown` from Slider.vue:151 never reaches this host.
Slider.vue:151 — `@pointerdown="onPointerDown"` on <SliderRoot> is the DEAD binding: type-valid (vue-tsc GREEN), units GREEN, runtime no-op.

preFix.comment: A native addEventListener('pointerdown') on the SAME data-slider-impl host DOES fire (the host receives the event) — proving the host is reachable; only the Vue template-attr path is dropped.

stateMachineShape.note: AX.W01/W02 rebuilt useDockState: keepOpenCount is a reactive ref; scheduleCollapse()/onMouseLeave()/onFocusOut() consult it SYNCHRONOUSLY (early-return when > 0); isHeld = computed(keepOpenCount > 0) is the SOLE data-held writer (GlassDock root + provided to descendants via DockContext.held). No token race: keepOpen()/release() mutate the ONE ref the state machine reads. The hold is therefore a synchronous reactive EDGE into the one state machine — the fix only needs to ARM the binding (native host listener) that calls keepOpen()/release().

fixDisposition.ratified: NATIVE-HOST-LISTENER path (charter §3 W03 ratify-before-impl). NOT the reka SliderRoot pressed/dragging-state subscription — reka exposes no stable public `dragging` ref on SliderRoot, and binding to it would re-introduce the forwarding-boundary fragility.
fixDisposition.diShape: consume the EXISTING typed DockContext (useOptionalDockContext: keepOpen/release/held) — no new injection key, no event bus. Preserves the O.W2 single-typed-key collapse + the keepOpen/portal DI contract keyframes.js dogfoods.

secondDefectFound.detail: The contract was DOUBLE-broken. Vue 3.5's reactive-props compiler applies Boolean CASTING to a type-only `keepDockOpen?: boolean`, so an ABSENT prop resolves to `false` (not `undefined`). The prior `computed(() => props.keepDockOpen ?? true)` therefore evaluated to `false` — the `??` never saw undefined — so even with the binding fixed, the default-true contract never armed. The fix: `withDefaults(defineProps<…>(), { keepDockOpen: true })` sets the true default at the prop level; an absent prop arms the hold, `:keep-dock-open="false"` disarms it.
secondDefectFound.witness: born-RED mount gate: with the host-native binding fix alone (before withDefaults) the pointer arm still read `acquire bail enabled=false` — the prop resolved false. withDefaults turned all 5 mount-gate arms GREEN.

postFixVerified_headless.bornRedAtHead: 4 of 5 hold-acquire arms FAIL at HEAD (data-held null after pointerdown/touch); the befitting-silent outside-dock arm passes (asserts NO held).

postFixVerified_headless.fullSuite: 830 tests / 87 files GREEN; typecheck GREEN; build GREEN (dist/slider.js + dist/dock.js emit).
